newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria's Zeroual calls for battle for economy.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's Zeroual calls for battle for economy.

text.p: Algeria's President Liamine Zeroual on Sunday urged Algerians to close ranks to battle for prosperity and development.

Zeroual told government officials, bankers, managers, academics, union and opposition representatives at the start of a five-day economic conference that Algeria was determined to mobilise its resources to ensure a better future for its 28 million people.

He urged the some 500 participants at the National Conference on the Economic and Social Development at the seaside complex of Club des Pins outside Algiers to work together to develop Algeria's true economic capabilities.
"Indeed, the most significant and difficult crisis that our country must truimph over is an economic one," Zeroual said in his speech broadcast by Algerian state-run radio and television.

Algeria is battling Moslem guerrillas and some estimated 50,000 people have been killed in the violence that broke out in early 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which the Islamists had taken a huge lead.
Among the economic problems in this oil and gas exporting North African country are 40 percent unemployment among those aged under 30, overcrowded housing and high food subsidy bills.
